description: Present developments in the Gulf Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet noted the information provided by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to the Cabinet on the prevailing state of affairs as a result of the breaking of diplomatic ties with the State of Qatar by the countries of Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Egypt, Bahrain and Yemen.
